turns.prompt_text: does there exists a machine or a device or tool that can cut dandelions so that I can get a large bundle of them
turns.response_html:
Yes, several tools can efficiently harvest dandelions in bulk depending on whether you want just the heads or the full stems.

Recommended Tools

  • Berry Picker / Scoop Header: This is a handheld device with metal or plastic "teeth." You comb it through the grass, and it pops the flower heads off into a collection bin.
  • Sickle or Scythe: For harvesting large bundles with stems intact, a hand sickle allows you to cut a wide swath of weeds near the base in one motion.
  • Hori Hori Knife: If you need the roots along with the bundle, this Japanese gardening tool acts as a serrated saw and a spade.
  • Rice Harvester (Manual): Small, serrated hand saws designed for grasses work perfectly for gathering thick bunches of dandelions quickly.

Efficiency Tip

To get a "large bundle" quickly, use a serrated sickle. Grasp a clump of dandelions with one hand and slice the base with the other. This keeps the stems aligned for easy bundling.
